rows.label: gradeIn weight: 1 before at, 0 after at + dur, 0.5 at the midpoint (soft ease); reverse mirrors it; amount scales it
gradient map: black -> first stop, white -> last stop, mid grey -> the middle stop (3 stops), any t after the window returns the source exactly
gradeIn .cube at weight 0.5 matches the JS reference within 0.00 levels; the SVG uses a table transfer and an arithmetic mix
gradeIn refuses one stop and an unknown ease
meshGradient, dotCondense, hologramBeam: the same t draws the same calls in any order (no history, no clock)
meshGradient loop 8: every blob repeats exactly after 8 s; without loop the field moves (t 0 != t 3)
dotCondense fewer: 220 dots before the cue, 20 after; merged dots keep the total ink area (1.000 of the start)
dotCondense line: every dot lands on the line between its ends; nothing mid-flight after at + stagger + dur
hologramBeam: off before at, beam and window fully on after at + on; all kinds mount through overlay.js
